name: Hotel Neri Barcelona
positioning: Hotel Neri occupies two historic buildings in the Gothic Quarter, one a 12th-century medieval palace, with interiors by Virginia Figueras and Franco Corada, terrace rooms with outdoor bathtubs and the Roba Estesa rooftop terrace
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside a 12th-century medieval palace in the Gothic Quarter
Couples who want a Deluxe Terrace room with an outdoor bathtub
Guests who want a room looking onto Plaza Sant Felip Neri

facts.text: Hotel Neri is in the heart of the Gothic Quarter, surrounded by the old Jewish quarter.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as hidden down a tiny, quiet alleyway off one of the prettiest squares in the Gothic Quarter.
The palace's old courtyard was recovered.
The sgraffito decorations found in the palace are considered among the most important in Barcelona.
The hotel's interior design is by Virginia Figueras and Franco Corada.
Rooms are decorated with photographs from the La Mirada Transeunte collection.
Classic rooms have views of the Gothic Quarter.
The Suite has a separate sitting area and keeps its original restored ceilings.
Conde Nast Traveler says the Junior Suite has views of Sant Felip Neri square.
A sleep preferences menu lets guests choose cotton, satin or linen sheets and down or hypoallergenic pillows.
Many of the natural stone bathrooms have both a bathtub and a rain shower.
a Restaurant is located on Plaza Sant Felip Neri.

highlights.text: Hotel Neri occupies two historic buildings, one of them a 12th-century medieval palace.
Deluxe Terrace rooms have a terrace with a relaxation area and an outdoor bathtub.
The Deluxe Balcony room overlooks Plaza Sant Felip Neri and has a balcony.
Roba Estesa is a rooftop terrace surrounded by greenery on the hotel's top floor.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Roba Estesa rooftop is reserved for guests and private events.
WhataHotel notes historic building constraints may mean smaller room sizes.
WhataHotel notes it is a small boutique property with limited room inventory.
